scripts.test:integration: pnpm build && { test -d test/integration || exit 0; test_files=$(find test/integration -type f -name '*.test.mjs'); test -z "$test_files" || node --test --test-concurrency=1 $test_files; }
scripts.test:contract: pnpm build && { test -d test/contract || exit 0; test_files=$(find test/contract -type f -name '*.test.mjs'); test -z "$test_files" || node --test $test_files; }
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build && { test -d test/e2e || exit 0; test_files=$(find test/e2e -type f -name '*.test.mjs'); test -z "$test_files" || node --test $test_files; }
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:contract && pnpm test:e2e
